headline: Dulux reveals sage green as Colour of the Year 2027
context: Paint brand Dulux has announced Soulful Sage – "a versatile green that provides a flexible foundation for schemes" – as its colour of the year for 2027. Dulux selected the soft grey-green as its annual colour of the year as it is a calm shade that has clear connections to nature.
